result:
No failures — the warnings are pre-existing (unrelated controllers missing test files). The fix is complete.

I fixed the missing authorization check in `PostController.destroy()` (`app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts`) — it now calls `await this.authorize('delete', [Post, post])` before deleting, mirroring the pattern already used in `update()`. This wires up `PostPolicy.delete()`, which was already defined but never invoked, so a signed-in non-author gets a 403 and the post survives; guests are already blocked by the `auth` middleware on the `posts.destroy` route, redirecting to `/login`. I added test coverage in `tests/PostController.test.ts` (a `posts.destroy` describe block) verifying: a non-author is forbidden and the post remains, a guest is redirected to login and the post remains, and the actual author can still delete their own post. `bun run typecheck`, `bun test` (5/5 passing), and `bunx guren check` (no new failures) all pass.
